newsitem.title: USA: IBP Inc cutting US pork plant hours next two weeks.
newsitem.headline: IBP Inc cutting US pork plant hours next two weeks.

text.p: Meatpacker IBP Inc said it is reducing operating hours at its U.S. pork plants by four to eight hours this week and next due to poor operating margins.
IBP operates seven pork plants in Iowa, Nebraska and Indiana with a total slaughter capacity estimated by industry sources of 79,000 hogs a day.
IBP said its plants recently have been running at about 40 hours per week but were expected to operate 32 to 36 hours both this week and next.
